title: Stitchpoint: 1:1 prep (Eden Yu → Aria Lin)
content:
Context: Aria's been rotating as acting tech lead for latency-inference-v2 while Priya is on parental leave. This 1:1 is a short, tactical check and a little career calibration — want to acknowledge the recent wins and clarify next sprint priorities. Meeting length: 30m. Tone: appreciative, direct, prioritization-first.

Agenda (30m)
- 0-3m: Quick personal check-in (home + energy) — one sentence from each.
- 3-10m: Status pulse on latency-inference-v2 (metrics + recent incidents) — I listen, ask clarifying questions.
- 10-20m: Focus area deep-dive — two decisions we need from Aria this week (routing policy for cold-starts; rollback criteria for quantized model).
- 20-27m: Career signal and growth — discuss milestone for IC4->IC5, evidence to collect, mentor pairing.
- 27-30m: Action items, owners, and next 1:1 date.

Prep notes for me (Eden) — items to surface explicitly
- Call out: Aria handled the p99 incident last Thursday well; mention specifics (coordinated rollback + postmortem draft).
- Confirm that the temporary routing policy (region fallback to west-2) reduced p95 by ~40ms; ask for numbers and linked dashboard.
- Pressure point: release-eng PR #3456 blocking progressive rollout. Ask if they need me to escalate to release eng manager.
- Coaching ask: encourage concise incident writeups (3 bullets: what, impact, follow-up) so execs can skim.

Metrics snapshot I expect Aria to mention (quick verification)
- p50: 18ms (stable)
- p95: target < 120ms; observed 140ms in last 24h (need root cause)
- error rate: 0.03% (ok)
- throughput: 1.2k req/s peak (within dedicated pool)

Open questions to pose
- Do you have enough runway to keep shipping the soft-fail fallback for quantized paths? Any infra limits?
- Where are you on the KV cache experiment? Is it reducing token cost as we expected?
- Do you feel ownership bandwidth is sustainable for next 6 weeks? If not, who should we backfill?

Career calibration (10m) talking points
- Concrete signals for IC5 promotion: consistent ownership of a cross-team rollout, measurable impact on cost/latency, documented mentorship of at least one peer.
- Evidence to collect over next 6 weeks: before/after dashboard snapshots, PRs where Aria was lead reviewer, 2 incident writeups showing escalation+resolution.
- Offer: I will pair them with Noah (systems mentoring) and set up a 1-hr shadow session with Priya on rollout policies.

Phrase bank — scripts to use if conversation stalls
- "I want to explicitly thank you for how you handled the incident; I saw you own the rollback and the postmortem — that matters."
- "Let's pick one thing this sprint that, if completed, will materially reduce p95 — what is the realistic bet?"
- "If you need me to unblock release-eng, I will ping Priya's counterpart and create a short escalation note."

Immediate action items (capture at end of meeting)
- Aria: produce 3-bullet incident summary and link to dashboard (due: EOD Thu).
- Aria: update KV cache experiment README with perf numbers and a 'go/no-go' recommendation (due: next Tue).
- Eden: escalate PR #3456 if not merged by Fri morning (owner: Eden).
- Eden + Noah: schedule 1-hr mentorship shadow (owner: Eden, target: within 2 weeks).

Notes to self (private)
- Watch for signs of burnout: Aria pushes cancellations and responds late to async — check energy level next week.
- If bandwidth is constrained, consider rotating a junior eng from infra for 2 sprints.
- Keep language specific and outcome-oriented; avoid abstract 'you're doing great' without examples.

Follow-up template to send after meeting (short email/Slack DM)
- Opening line: "Great sync — appreciate you owning the incident this week. Notes and actions below."
- Paste action items with owners & dates.
- Add one sentence about career step we're tracking (e.g., "We'll collect the three promotion signals over next 6 weeks").

Back-pocket escalation text (only if needed)
- "Hi Priya's counterpart — Eden here. PR #3456 is gating a progressive rollout that materially reduces p95 for our dedicated customers. Can you prioritize a quick review or point me to someone who can? Thanks."

End-state I want from this 1:1
- Clear ownership from Aria on two tactical decisions this week.
- Observable artifacts (incident summary, KV experiment README) within the deadlines.
- A plan for mentorship and a visible path toward IC5 with measurable signals.

Misc scratch (if time allows)
- Suggest we try a 10-minute async status in writing for next two sprints to reduce meeting time; capture on weekly doc.
- Flag specific docs for Aria: confluence/INF-latency-runbook (refresh), runbook:rollback-criteria.md (needs one-line criterion).

End.
